parameters.content:
## Meta webhook check
Meta calls this once with a GET request when you save the webhook URL in your Meta app. It only returns the challenge if the verify token matches.

## 1. Security
Meta signs every webhook with your app secret. Anything without a valid signature stops here and raises an alert.

## 2. Conversation
Receipts are ignored and photos or voice notes get a polite ask for text. Claude reads the chat so far, records the answers and asks the next question. If Claude or WhatsApp fails, the lead still hears back and you get an alert.

## 3. Save the lead
Runs once per lead, when all five details are in: GoHighLevel contact (no duplicates), tags, a note with the details, then a Slack alert. If GoHighLevel fails, Slack says so and the save is retried on the next message.

parameters.errorMessage: Webhook call rejected: the X-Hub-Signature-256 header is missing or wrong. If real WhatsApp messages land here, check WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET.
